title: DNS Daddy product claims inventory
description: Structured source for website-consumable claims and documentation tables. Maturity is separate from the strength of validation evidence: an automated test is not an independent review. Availability describes where the claim is true today (main vs experimental vs planned vs open PR).

dependencies.note: Feed provenance checksums/parser counts and hash-chained configuration history. Do not advertise as released until merged.

claims.title: Fresh installs start in Forward with default Cloudflare DoH
claims.scope: Fresh installs without an explicit resolver-mode override start in Forward (off) and use the default Cloudflare DoH forwarding URLs unless configuration says otherwise. Upgrades retain saved mode; explicit configuration takes precedence.
caveats: Saved dashboard or YAML mode pins override the fresh-install default.
Mode, transport encryption and DNSSEC are separate controls.

claims.title: Mode, transport encryption and DNSSEC are separate
claims.scope: Forward/Learn/Live selection is independent of the native versus encrypted outbound profile. Inbound DoH/DoT listeners differ from outbound DoQ/HTTP3/HTTP2 support.
caveats: Encrypted outbound profile does not imply inbound DoQ/HTTP3 listeners.
Live local validation remains experimental.

claims.title: Learn observation does not authenticate an already-returned answer
claims.scope: In Learn mode the client answer comes from the selected profile's forwarding path. Daddybound independently observes afterwards and cannot authenticate or change that answer.
caveats: Learn verdicts are observational evidence only.

claims.title: Live local validation remains experimental
claims.scope: Native or encrypted Live validation can SERVFAIL on bogus/indeterminate/operational failures. CD requests skip DNSSEC checking while policy and rebinding still apply. Existing failure/CD semantics remain intact.
caveats: Implementation and default selection do not establish production reliability.
Verified Trust laboratory evidence is offline conformance, not an external audit.

claims.title: Behavioural detectors and local learning are experimental and alert-only
claims.scope: Detectors and the local learner raise findings and do not block domains by themselves. A false-positive review changes no enforcement.
caveats: Synthetic evaluation is not a production false-positive rate.

claims.title: Safe Search is not enforced
claims.scope: The deprecated safeSearch policy field is stored for compatibility and does not rewrite answers or restrict search engines.
caveats: Future CNAME rewriting would require a separate answer-path change and review.

claims.title: Map edges are retained DNS query relationships
claims.scope: DNS Security Map edges mean recorded query_log relationships for the selected window, not visits, TCP connections or discovered L2/L3 topology.
caveats: Optional UniFi/pfSense/SNMPv3 collectors remain deferred.
Respects query-log and client-IP privacy controls.

claims.title: Local first-seen is not registration age
claims.scope: domain_first_seen records local observation of a registered domain (eTLD+1). It is independent of query-log retention and is not WHOIS age or threat intelligence.
caveats: Writes only when query-log admission would also persist a row.

claims.title: Client IP and manual naming are not authenticated identity
claims.scope: Operator-assigned client names carry confidence operator and source manual. Unknown remains valid when no name exists. Source IP is not authenticated device identity.
caveats: Lease/PTR enrichment remains planned and evidence-gated.

claims.title: Observatory integration retirement is distinct from website status
claims.scope: Legacy Observatory integration is retired in-process. That is unrelated to whether any separate marketing website is operating.
caveats: Do not infer website uptime from product code paths.

claims.title: Audit and benchmark limitations remain visible
claims.scope: Available means implemented and tested, not adversarially audited. Synthetic evaluation and laboratory reports are not independent production efficacy claims. Constrained 1 GB / 1 vCPU targets remain unverified unless that environment was measured.
caveats: Formatting or CI green alone does not prove a claim matches implementation.

claims.title: Client access is operator-selected and narrowly scoped
claims.scope: DNS Daddy never automatically widens ACLs or authorises observed clients merely to make a diagnostic pass. Default ad-hoc access only covers unmatched clients already inside the configured ACL.
caveats: Completed responses are not proof of remote delivery, NAT mapping or firewall reachability.

claims.title: Restore targets a fresh directory and never overwrites a live database
claims.scope: Encrypted backup packages database, secrets key and recovery files. Restore verifies into a new private directory and revokes restored sessions. Live databases are preserved.
caveats: A passing backup test is not a downgrade guarantee.
Already-published binaries without schema-generation checks are not retroactively protected.

claims.title: Feed supply-chain evidence and hash-chained journal
claims.scope: Extended feed refresh evidence (URL, checksum, parser rejects, last-success age) and hash-chained management history are tracked in open PR #104 and must not be advertised as released until merged.
caveats: Existing cached-feed fallback is not signed publisher provenance.
A local hash chain is not protection against a compromised host.

claims.title: dnsdaddy doctor diagnoses deployments without mutating the database
claims.scope: doctor opens the database read-only, may send explicit bounded probes, and exits non-zero on failure. It does not widen ACLs or change saved modes.
caveats: Active probes are part of doctor; support export defaults to offline collection.

claims.title: dnsdaddy support writes a local allowlisted diagnostic package
claims.scope: Offline-by-default support export with an explicit allowlist, restrictive permissions, preview/manifest and no upload. Active doctor probes require an explicit option and are labelled separately.
caveats: Hashed domains/IPs are not anonymous and are not included by default.
Sharing is a separate manual action.
